title: Child mortality, 1751-2013
claim_summary: Child mortality declined dramatically in representative countries.
book_citation: Our World in Data, Roser 2016a, based on UN Child Mortality Estimates and the Human Mortality Database.
notes: Immutable OWID CME Info 2016 data were recovered from repository history, but they start in 1970 and are only one component of the cited source. The exact Roser 2016a UN/HMD assembly remains unrecovered. The plot uses current OWID successor values clipped to book-visible starts, with no post-2013 extension.
